note: How often a candidate is asked again (src/coprepan/schedule.py). Part of the acquisition policy (master plan O-1), decided for the first real canary only (CPD-0013). The values are deliberately slow: within a bounded canary nothing is asked twice except by an explicit, recorded retry. A success is not revisited within a day and no longer after a week; a transient failure (a transport error, a 429, a 5xx) waits an hour, then doubles, and after three in a row the candidate is suspended for a week — a Retry-After that asks for longer wins; a 404 or 410 is looked at once more after a week and then retired; a refusal by the server, a redirect that was not followed and a denial by the policy wait a week; a permanent redirect moves the candidate to its target; conditional requests are used where a validator and the preserved body exist. No value adapts by itself. Scheduled crawling needs a new version.
